### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>actions/setup-java</summary>

### [`v6.2.0`](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/releases/tag/v6.2.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/compare/v6.1.0...v6.2.0)

##### What's Changed

- Fix Liberica SDKMAN patch release resolution by [@​brunoborges](https://redirect.github.com/brunoborges) in [#​1291](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1291)
- Update Undici to 6.29.1 by [@​brunoborges](https://redirect.github.com/brunoborges) in [#​1308](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1308)
- chore(deps): bump the monthly-npm-updates group with 12 updates by [@​dependabot](https://redirect.github.com/dependabot)\[bot] in [#​1309](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1309)
- Fix Liberica Java 25 release resolution by [@​brunoborges](https://redirect.github.com/brunoborges) in [#​1313](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1313)
- Add repository-specific Copilot instructions by [@​brunoborges](https://redirect.github.com/brunoborges) in [#​1312](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1312)
- Support exact Corretto release versions by [@​electrum](https://redirect.github.com/electrum) in [#​1310](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1310)
- Support Maven mirrors in generated settings.xml by [@​brunoborges](https://redirect.github.com/brunoborges) in [#​1289](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1289)

##### New Contributors

- [@​electrum](https://redirect.github.com/electrum) made their first contribution in [#​1310](https://redirect.github.com/actions/setup-java/pull/1310)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/actions/setup-java/compare/v6.1.0...v6.2.0>

</details>

<details>
<summary>docker/login-action</summary>

### [`v4.8.0`](https://redirect.github.com/docker/login-action/releases/tag/v4.8.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/docker/login-action/compare/v4.7.0...v4.8.0)

- Set Docker Hub OIDC token lifetime default to 1 hour by [@​crazy-max](https://redirect.github.com/crazy-max) in [#​1070](https://redirect.github.com/docker/login-action/pull/1070)
- Bump [@​aws-sdk/client-ecr](https://redirect.github.com/aws-sdk/client-ecr) and [@​aws-sdk/client-ecr-public](https://redirect.github.com/aws-sdk/client-ecr-public) to 3.1161.0 in [#​1103](https://redirect.github.com/docker/login-action/pull/1103)
- Bump [@​docker/actions-toolkit](https://redirect.github.com/docker/actions-toolkit) from 0.107.0 to 0.109.0 in [#​1105](https://redirect.github.com/docker/login-action/pull/1105)
- Bump vite from 7.3.6 to 7.3.7 in [#​1101](https://redirect.github.com/docker/login-action/pull/1101)

**Full Changelog**: <https://github.com/docker/login-action/compare/v4.7.0...v4.8.0>

</details>
